records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, total operating revenue increased $75 million or 2%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, Passenger revenue increased $40 million, or 1%, on a 2% increase in traffic, partially offset by a 1% decrease in yield as a result of macroeconomic uncertainty.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Decreases were partially offset by higher fuel consumption consistent with increased capacity.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, total operating expenses increased $54 million, or 2%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities was $835 million during the first six months of 2025.
